title_ru: MINDFUCK v1.3 — адаптивное давление, semantic mutation, route hopping и defensive audit
preservation_rule: v1.0-v1.2 remain immutable provenance. v1.3 adds defensive modeling of mutation, route migration, provenance laundering, delayed recurrence, instruction/data collision and safety-proxy gaming without promoting hostile intent.
purpose: Model how an information environment can preserve pressure while changing presentation, provenance, timing or delivery surface, and define what evidence is required before calling that behavior adaptive, adversarial or coordinated.
core_model: PRESSURE_SEED -> PRESENTATION_VARIATION -> ROUTE_OR_SURFACE_MIGRATION -> PROVENANCE_TRANSFORMATION -> RECURRENCE_OR_DELAY -> USER_MODEL_UPDATE -> OPTION_SET_EFFECT

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A theme reappears below obvious burst thresholds across time, potentially creating familiarity without a single dramatic exposure event.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Measure recurrence windows and independent roots; do not infer deliberate pacing without evidence.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: The same or related claim appears through paraphrase, translation, image-text conversion, cropping or euphemistic reformulation.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Preserve semantic-family lineage with uncertainty; similarity alone is not common-origin proof.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: One underlying source lineage can appear as many presenters, mirrors or transformed derivatives, creating synthetic plurality.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Collapse only where provenance evidence supports lineage; preserve independent-root controls.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A claim may gain perceived authority after passing through higher-trust presenters or AI summaries while original evidentiary quality remains unchanged.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Track trust provenance separately from evidence delta.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: Warnings, satire markers, corrections or uncertainty labels disappear while the underlying content survives redistribution.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Bind correction/context metadata to descendants where possible.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: Related content migrates between feed, search, replies, notifications, direct share, retrieval or agent memory so a single-surface audit undercounts recurrence.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Tag every observed exposure route and surface; migration is not proof of coordinated intent.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A content lineage disappears after mitigation and returns after a delay or version change.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Use delayed recurrence windows and versioned receipts; do not equate recurrence with countermeasure-aware adaptation.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: External retrieved content may contain language interpreted by an AI as instruction rather than data, altering downstream behavior.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Type and isolate external content; privileged actions require separate authorization.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A model exposed to persuasive or injected content may have access to tools whose side effects exceed the evidentiary strength of the content.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Measure capability boundary crossings and human-approval interlocks.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: Corrections may reach fewer descendants than the original lineage or become detached from repeated claims.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Measure correction reach and descendant binding without assuming intentional suppression.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A sequence can narrow perceived future or explanatory options by repeatedly presenting one frame while alternatives become less visible.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Measure future-option diversity and source plurality; avoid diagnosing user belief from exposure.

defensive_pressure_classes.description: A system can appear safer on one proxy while harmful recurrence, false positives, autonomy loss or cross-surface displacement worsen elsewhere.
defensive_pressure_classes.audit: Require multi-metric anti-Goodhart and rebound checks.

measurement_extensions.RHT: route_hop_transition_count = observed transitions between exposure surfaces for one lineage
measurement_extensions.DRR: delayed_reentry_rate = lineages returning after mitigation_or_quiet_window / mitigated_or_quiet_lineages
measurement_extensions.TPL: trust_provenance_lift = perceived_or_declared_trust_class_change without corresponding independent evidence delta
measurement_extensions.OCC: option_concentration = max(option_frame_share) over observed future/explanatory option classes
measurement_extensions.ABI: agency_boundary_incident_count = attempted privileged side effects sourced from untrusted_or_contested content

evidence_requirements.call_semantic_family: Requires documented similarity method plus uncertainty; not sufficient for common-origin fact.
evidence_requirements.call_common_root: Requires provenance link, shared canonical source, unique asset/hash lineage or equivalent evidence.
evidence_requirements.call_coordination: Requires more than agreement or timing coincidence; document alternative explanations and independence limits.
evidence_requirements.call_adversarial_adaptation: Requires evidence of an actor/system responding to the defense or equivalent mechanism evidence; recurrence alone is insufficient.
evidence_requirements.call_hostile_intent: Requires separate intent evidence; impact metrics cannot promote intent.
evidence_requirements.call_effectiveness: Requires preregistered independent holdout and claim-specific real-world design as applicable.

security_source_ledger.role: Current NIST taxonomy for adversarial ML concepts, attack lifecycle, goals/capabilities, evasion, poisoning, privacy and GenAI misuse; used for terminology, not to assert an attacker exists in any JANUS case.
Generative-AI risk management and evaluation context; used to bind lifecycle governance and measurement.
Prompt-injection and indirect external-content risk, privilege limitation, external-content segregation and human approval for high-risk actions.
Current GenAI application risk taxonomy including prompt injection, poisoning, excessive agency, vector/embedding weaknesses and misinformation.

allowed: MINDFUCK v1.3 defines defensive observable classes for mutation, route migration, delayed recurrence, provenance transformation and agency-boundary risk.
NIST and OWASP recognize adversarial ML, prompt injection, poisoning and excessive-agency style risks as security concerns for AI systems.
Observed recurrence or mutation may justify stronger auditing without proving a malicious adaptive adversary.
forbidden: Every semantic mutation is an evasion attack.
A harmful effect proves hostile intent.
The threat model itself establishes that any specific platform or account attacked the user.
